title: Database Core compatibility is an adapter, not namespace fusion
summary: NoSQLServer exposes a namespaced Database Core adapter because both packages publish overlapping public class names with different observable semantics. Do not ::requires both complete class sets into one package namespace merely to gain compatibility.
invariants: Preserve native DatabaseRow, DatabaseValue, transaction, planner and staged-publication semantics.
Capability queries are preferred to engine-name tests.
Common error/operation aliases are acceptable only where semantics truly match.
The adapter is a compatibility boundary, not authority to redesign the native engine.
